pages.text: Board your mecha as a jar, or linked while carrying your head: use it. Only its owner and players they trust can. To get out, hold $(k:key.sneak) and $(k:key.headinajar.jar_menu) for a second. Anyone with a body may ride in a Passenger Pod or a Wheelhouse seat.

$(k:key.attack) works the left arm, $(k:key.use) the right. $(k:key.jump) jumps, or fires jets in the air. $(k:key.headinajar.ability) fires the chosen utility, $(k:key.headinajar.secondary) picks the next; add $(k:key.sneak) for the mecha's genes. $(k:key.headinajar.swap) opens the Cargo Hold.
